correctness.rationale: The exact four-branch weighted PAV center rule gives a cyclic tridiagonal stochastic Jacobian. In edge coordinates, each input-edge column has absolute sum max(1,2(alpha_right+gamma_left)-1), bounded by K. Segment integration supplies the universal inequality. Two decreasing edges separated by four positions force maximal adjacent pooling with disjoint difference packets, and exact finite perturbations attain K for every n>=8 and all positive weights. The decoded checker ran 5,000 exact-rational inequalities, 30 exact attainment tests, four branch tests. No finite search is substituted for proof.

value.rationale: A natural sliding weighted order-constrained smoother has an exact robust/nonrobust phase transition precisely at center weight b=sqrt(ac). The theorem determines the full quantitative gain and finite extremizers above that boundary, solving an exact input-difference stability question not supplied by ordinary PAV algorithms or one-input TVD bounds. This provides motivated, interpretable guidance for local weighting without requiring a larger downstream theorem.
